patches.summary: Preserves the original Client2 render container and top-control geometry, then adds hidden-by-default AIOS overlays without resizing the Unity surface. Navigation opens fixed tasks and phone opens bounded free-form input.

Requests Runtime and debug-simulation signature permissions and declares explicit Runtime package visibility without INTERNET or cleartext access; the debug controller service remains absent from Runtime release.
Uses a one-line MainActivity hook to install the maintained Java CockpitControlCoordinator immediately after setContentView.

Embeds the ScenarioClient-backed Session implementation, formal OrchestrationClient V1 projection, immutable HMI state, owner-scoped consume-once free-form model input, and UI-only actuator feedback. It does not install a TuanjieView touch listener, change render scale, call RenderService messages, or depend on a modified Unity bundle.

non_goals: production direct NPU or model access from app UI
libtuanjie.so or vendor Android system image modification
